title: Spectrum stack
description: Fine logarithmic frequency bands reveal the harmonics of an adjustable synthesized tone.
useCase: Show where energy is concentrated; make a filter adjustment legible.
interaction: Enable sound and change oscillator frequency.
reducedMotion: Bars update without interpolated motion at four samples per second; sound remains opt-in.
limitations: Uses a native oscillator and AnalyserNode. Idle bands are an analytical preview, not live microphone data.
look: Muted steel-blue panel with forty thin cream vertical bars on a faint grid, a large light-weight frequency readout, log-scale labels, a slider and cream button.
motion: With sound enabled, 40 log-spaced bars scale to AnalyserNode levels sampled every 33 ms with 70 ms linear transitions; before that, the slider redraws an analytical harmonic preview.
adapt: `toggle` routes a sawtooth `OscillatorNode` through an `AnalyserNode` (`fftSize` 2048); a `setInterval` effect maps bins to 40 log bands in `levels`, and `previewBands` draws the idle state. Swap the oscillator for a media or microphone source; keep `stop` and `closeContext`.
